svg.text: Dominus Pizza: proposed store layout (v2, from the planograms)
Top-down, street at the bottom. 60 x 50 studs = 40 x 33 ft (about 1,330 sq ft).
dough tray dollies in a U at the far end
10 studs = 6 ft 8 in (1.5 studs per foot)
Short order counter (6 ft 6 in, 2 POS) at the end of the dough
show, safe under it out of view, gate into the kitchen, menu
boards above, tracker TV, drinks, bench, carryout pass-through.
S / M / L trays of dough balls on the first stretch table (click a
ball), more trays on dollies under it. Farthest from the makeline,
The ball drops into the cornmeal pile and is pressed and stretched
there (your video); cornmeal bin under the table.
Screens (disc holder) and the two skin racks; under-counter fridge
below. Butts straight into the makeline: no gap.
12 ft: sauce bucket at the start on the cornmeal catcher, then
cheese, then toppings. Rail pans in planogram order: big cheese
pan, pepperoni, then ham, peppers, mushrooms, pineapple, olives.
Ready rack and screen stacks at the makeline end, one step from
3 stacked conveyors under one hood, loaded at the front, out
toward the back; belts and pulleys animated. Visible from the
5 ft, at 90 degrees to the oven exits and one step away. Speed
rail with rocker and sauce bottles, top-mix boxes on top, Ready
& Set shelf with the dispatch screens, caddie at the far
corner, pan organizer, trash, metrics TV above.
Deliveries, turned so it isn't parallel to the front counter
(keeps sightlines open); bag rack by the back door.
Flat boxes along the wall beside the cut table.
8 x 16 ft, door on the long side 28 in from the end, facing the
run; dough tray dollies in a U at the far end, racks and dunnage
by the door; short route from the back door.
3-compartment sink on the side wall, hand sink by the run, prep
